message: Why is S01 only a medium shot? It's the first image of the flashback.
reply: Good question — I kept S01 as a medium shot because I wanted the flashback to feel intimate, not cinematic-showy. Story-wise, this is a private, measured moment between Nimal and Dinu; a restrained MS places us close enough to read their body language and the closed box between them, but it still lets both characters share the frame so the power dynamic is visible. From the craft side: the handheld, eye‑level MS gives a quiet, observational presence and leaves room for the editor to cut to inserts and tighter reactions (we have those planned). The composition holds the box low in the centre and keeps an open upper area for timing beats or an editorial title, while the rain on the roof and practical lighting read well at that scale. If we opened wider it would make the scene feel more distant; tighter immediately would steal away the two‑person exchange we need here.
